summary.plain: A small tank of liquid argon, about fifty kilograms of it, that watched for dark matter particles bumping into argon atoms deep under an Italian mountain.
summary.technical: Dual-phase argon TPC, ~50 kg nominal active mass (46.4+-0.7 kg measured), surrounded by a 30 t liquid-scintillator neutron veto inside a 1 kt water-Cherenkov muon veto, in LNGS Hall C.
